# Pakistan Driving License Test — Free Traffic Signs Quiz

> Free Pakistan driving license test practice — 100+ traffic signs quiz in English & Urdu. L-shape and S-shape driving track guide, DLIMS Punjab, Sindh & Islamabad portals.

## About

[drivetestpk.com](https://drivetestpk.com) is a free educational web application helping Pakistani citizens prepare for their driving license test. The app provides:

- Interactive traffic sign quiz (10, 30, or 50 questions) in English and Urdu
- Complete gallery of 100+ Pakistan traffic signs with English and Urdu names
- Step-by-step visual guide for L-Shape and S-Shape practical driving tracks
- Direct links to official DLIMS Punjab, DLS Sindh, and ITP Islamabad portals

## Pages

- [Home](https://drivetestpk.com/) — Main navigation hub
- [Quiz](https://drivetestpk.com/quiz) — Practice traffic sign quiz
- [Learn Signs](https://drivetestpk.com/learn) — Traffic sign gallery and guide
- [Driving Tracks](https://drivetestpk.com/tracks) — L-Shape and S-Shape track photos
- [Helpful Links](https://drivetestpk.com/links) — Official government license portals

## Key Facts

- Language support: English and Urdu (اردو)
- Quiz modes: Short (10 questions), Medium (30 questions), Long (50 questions)
- All content is freely accessible — no login or payment required
- Target audience: Pakistan driving license applicants (Punjab, Sindh, Islamabad)
- Official DLIMS portals covered: [Punjab](https://dlims.punjab.gov.pk), [Sindh](https://dlsonline.sindhpolice.gov.pk), [Islamabad](https://dlims.islamabadpolice.gov.pk)
